notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper and Draugr Recruiter do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block and kill Draugr Recruiter.
description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Declare Draugr Recruiter as an attacker.
Activate Draugr Recruiter by paying {3}{B}, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to your hand.
In your postcombat main phase, cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.
